newsitem.title: USA: Hooters faces sex harassment suit.
newsitem.headline: Hooters faces sex harassment suit.

text.p: A lawsuit described as a "major class action sexual harassment lawsuit" has been filed against Hooters of America Inc, said an attorney for one of the plaintiffs.

"The class action alleges that Hooters puts its female employees at risk of sexual harassment through the uniforms that it requires them to wear and the marketing of its restaurants," attorney Thomas Henderson told a news conference.
The lawsuit was filed on behalf of a woman who worked at Hooters in Myrtle Beach, S.C., and complained of sexual harassment.

She said the company had not supported her in her complaint, and in fact, had filed suit against her after she complained, which prompted her to file a suit on her own behalf and seek to make it a class action against the Atlanta-based restaurant chain.
Henderson said the lawsuit does not seek specific damages and said he was not sure how many people might be part of the class.
"We will have to determine in discovery the number of employees that are subjected to these agreements and procedures," he told the news conference.
